manifest.name: dsh-maoying
manifest.description: 毛颖 — DSH 网文创作辅助插件：主编 + 五帮手编排（大纲/写手/审校/设定/考据），novel/ 结构化文件为数据库

bundle.text:
# dsh-maoying bundle patch — `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-maoying` 时由
# reconcilePlugins 并入该 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles，boot 时并入补丁树。
# name: dsh-maoying 指向 pnpm 装进 profile 的本包（main: index.mjs）。
- insert:
    - id: maoying-installer
      name: dsh-maoying

readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

毛颖者，笔也——韩愈作《毛颖传》，把一支毛笔写成有封地有爵位的臣子。dsh-maoying 把这支笔装进 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）：**一支管着一班帮手、守着一摞书稿的毛笔**——网文创作辅助插件，全部实现原创，MIT 发布。

装上之后，主 agent 变身**网文主编（创作总监）**：带七阶段工作流与六步写作法，把大纲、正文、审校、设定维护、素材考据分别委派给五个只带本行工具的帮手；整部小说就是工作区里的 `novel/` 结构化 markdown/YAML 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、线索板、叙事记忆）——agent 直接读写文件，**没有数据库，没有 API 层**。查「所有未回收伏笔」就是 grep 一行。

- **主编 + 五帮手**：主 agent 当主编，只做规划、衔接、验收、状态推进；大纲师（outline）、写手（draft）、审校（review）、设定管理员（lore）、素材调研员（research）各带本行工具随叫随到。找文件、查伏笔状态这类顺手小事主编自己 glob/grep 就办，不绕委派。
- **novel/ 文件数据库**：角色卡、世界观、科学设定三色标注、关系图、伏笔账本、时间线、叙事记忆、线索板、拍板账，全部是 grep 友好的平键/顶层数组 YAML——人可直接改，git 可版本化，无迁移无运维。
- **七阶段工作流**：idea 选题 → setting 设定 → outline 大纲 → writing 写作 → review 审阅 → consistency 一致性 → export 导出。阶段记在 project.yml 的 phase 键，每完成一个里程碑主编推进并简报；推进有完成判据（核心设定落盘、分卷规划与目标章大纲在案才进 writing），不满足就回上一阶段补齐。
- **Writing 六步法**：衔接检查 → 出大纲 → 写正文 → 审稿 → 修改 → 定稿维护，逐章循环；配合 Collab 四步共创（设定共创 → 分卷规划 → 黄金三章 → 交接循环）把新书从零带到滚动更新；设定一览与分卷规划各设一个用户拍板点，前三章在设定齐备前不开工。
- **伏笔状态机**：planted（埋设）→ progressing（推进）→ resolved（回收）/ abandoned（弃用），埋设与回收记章节号、预期回收章节排期、优先级分档——长篇不断线，活跃伏笔超 15 条主编主动提醒清理。
- **上下文按需取**：主编先读 index.yml 概览，写到哪章读哪章（前章结尾约 1500 字 + 该章大纲 + 出场角色卡 + 活跃伏笔节选），不把整本书塞进上下文。
- **工具面收窄**：主编只见「角色委派 + 内部检索 + 协调」白名单，帮手各带本行工具（审校只读、考据只带联网+落笔记）；每次请求的工具开销与上下文占用随之下降。
- **素材考据**：research 帮手联网检索历史/地理/专业领域素材，笔记落 `novel/research/`，区分史实/通说/演义并附来源——DSH 架构的红利。
- **创作台面板**：DSH 侧栏一键打开的可视化创作台——默认中栏全页面板，也可按「打开方式」设置整体搬进右侧栏（分栏：创作台中栏 + 文章页右侧栏 tab / 中间栏 / 右侧栏三选一，宿主 0.2.x 支持右侧栏）——概览（含书稿元信息编辑与分卷规划）/章节/角色/伏笔/关系图/时间线/设定/写作风格/索引板九个 tab；章节整页阅读（章纲对照 + 正文/章纲编辑保存 + 五维 + 状态流转）、project.

前置：**Node.js ≥ 18**、已装好的 DSH host（**0.1.7+**，见「兼容面」）。

官方插件通道——一条命令，装完重启即用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maoying
```

**重启 DSH（`dsh web`）**：插件启动时自动把预设装进 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/maoying/`，并写好声明行托管块，无需再点任何按钮。托管块写入层自动选择：桌面/服务器默认写 home 级 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`；Android compat 壳环境（该壳每次启动会把 home 级 patch 重写坏）自动改写 profile 级 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`——壳不碰 profile 层，插件每次启动补写自愈，并顺手清掉 home 级遗留托管块防双声明；也可用环境变量 `DSH_MAOYING_PATCH_LAYER=home|profile` 强制指定。新会话的预设选择器里选「**毛颖创作 (Maoying)**」即可开写；要设为默认，在 Settings → Agent Presets 里选。

开发检出（想改插件或预设源码）用 link 形态直连仓库，改动经重启生效：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-maoying.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-maoying"
```

只要命令行工具、不装插件的读者：零依赖 CLI 单独可用，`npx` 即跑，或装成全局命令（均为 npm 通道，与插件互不相干）：

```bash
npx maoying init                 # 免安装直接跑
npm install -g dsh-maoying       # 或装成全局 maoying 命令
```

选好预设后，对主编说话即可，它按工作流自己路由：

**开新书（Collab 四步共创）**：

> 我想写一本东方玄幻，主角靠「听懂器物说话」的金手指鉴宝升级。

主编与你逐项对齐设定（题材、金手指、基调、主角三要素、对抗主线），设定管理员落盘核心角色卡与世界观条目后交你拍板；大纲师出分卷规划再交你拍板——设定与分卷都定了，才动笔黄金三章（立世界钩子、立主角动机、立核心冲突）交付。

**逐章写作（Writing 六步法）**：

> 第三章可以开写了吗？

主编做衔接检查，委派大纲师出本章大纲（含五维叙事字段），过目后派写手写正文、审校审稿（清单 + 一致性扫描：冲突/时间线/伏笔/设定 + 连贯六维：行为/因果/资源/身份/伤势/战力），有问题回写手修，通过后由设定管理员一次跑完定稿维护（章纲对照 + 五本账 + index 重建 + 一致性核对，全部落盘才置 accepted）——你只需要在决策点拍板。

**集中审查**：

> 前 20 章做一次一致性检查。

主编推进 phase 到 consistency，审校扫描冲突/时间线/伏笔/设定与连贯六维（行为/因果/资源/身份/伤势/战力），问题按严重度排好交回写手。

用户回「ok / 可以 / 继续」即视为确认，主编直接推进，不复述确认。

DSH 左侧栏底部点「**毛颖创作台**」打开创作台（改文件、跑流程之外，给肉眼看的驾驶舱）。打开方式在面板系统设置里三选一（立即记忆，对下一次打开生效）：

- **分栏**（默认）：创作台在中栏全页，点章节/最近更新开**文章页右侧栏 tab**——阅读/编辑与创作台同屏对照；
- **中间栏**：两者都在中栏（0.1.25 及以前的唯一形态）；
- **右侧栏**：两者都在右侧栏 tab（需 DSH 0.2.x；0.1.x 宿主设置里右栏两项置灰，一切按中间栏走）。

右侧栏 tab 切走/切会话/收栏都不卸载（草稿保活），重新打开即拉最新内容；文章页换章会重挂编辑器，30 秒自动保存窗口内的未存稿不保留。中栏形态行为不变：

- **章节**：状态筛选 + 按单写作清单；点章节进整页阅读——返回按钮、章纲对照（Markdown 渲染）、正文与章纲就地编辑保存（正文 textarea 自动保存——待写空章节与写作中（status=writing）章节打开即直接进编辑器、约 30 秒防抖落盘、手动/自动保存都停留在编辑态续写、回车换行自动加段首两个全角空格缩进、编辑栏实时显示正文字数（不含标点/含标点双口径）、章节标题可在编辑器顶部修改（与正文一次原子保存）、编辑器带行号（逻辑行号、随软换行对齐）、编辑器字号可缩放（A−/A+，localStorage 记忆）、编辑器字体可选（下拉：系统默认+黑体/宋体/楷体/仿宋/霞鹜文楷，阅读与编辑同源生效，localStorage 记忆）、可全屏编辑（Esc 退出）、阅读模式一键返回只读（脏稿先确认）；章纲 textarea 手动保存；文件在编辑期间被外部改过时拒绝保存并放回磁盘最新内容，不覆盖人工改动）、五维叙事字段、一键状态流转。
- **概览**：书稿卡右上「编辑」按钮展开 project.yml 的书名/作者/题材/篇幅/语言/工作流阶段/共创模式/简介表单化编辑（原「小说设置」tab 并入），保存保留文件里原有注释；表单载入后 project.yml 被外部（作者手改 / agent 推进阶段）改过时拒绝保存并提示重改，不覆盖人工改动。概览另设「分卷规划」卡，列出 volumes.yml 各卷定位与计划章节范围——拍板过的分卷有处可查，卡头「编辑源文件」可整文件编辑 volumes.yml。
- **受管文件写面**：角色/设定/科学设定卡与六本账本（关系/时间线/记忆/线索板/伏笔/分卷）均可从面板编辑源文件——墙头「新建」、卡详情「编辑源文件/删除文件」、各账本卡头「编辑源文件」（时间线/关系图空态也给入口）；保存时结构校验（账本须是条目数组、实体卡须带 frontmatter 围栏，不合即拒存），外部改动保护与正文编辑同口径；章节阅读页可新建章纲（本章目标/节拍/出场角色/需埋需收伏笔/与前章接口五件骨架预填）、删除章纲与删除章节——删除均确认弹层，不可逆，后悔靠 git，静态体检会把孤儿引用标出来。
- **顶栏**：当前版本号常驻；npm 上有新版时亮「有新版 ↗」徽章直连发布页，旁边「一键升级」按钮直接用 pnpm 把最新包装进当前 DSH 档（仅支持 profile 目录安装，pnpm 缺失时自动回落 corepack；检测到全局 `maoying` CLI 时顺带以同一精确版本更新，未装则跳过；装完需重启 DeepSeek 才生效）；「检测更新」按钮只在无新版时显示（有新版时收起，让位给徽章与「一键升级」），点击手动现测线上最新版（绕过 1h 缓存——面板打开时只自动拉一次，页面开久了也不聋）；版本区后的齿轮打开系统设
面板写状态（章节状态、project.yml、index.yml 重建），正文/章纲/账本/实体卡等全部人工编辑入口只给人用（hash 旧版检测 + 结构校验，外部改动一律拒绝覆盖）——agent 的创作边界不变：共创模式下正文永远归作者与主编。

不是谁都想让 AI 代笔。project.yml 的 `mode` 键决定正文归谁写，三种模式一句话：`ai-draft`（默认）AI 代笔，走 Writing 六步法；`co-write` 逐章指派谁写，主编动笔前先问清本章归谁；`author-draft` 全书作者亲笔，毛颖只备料、审稿、记账，永不代写。

author-draft 下的协作循环——你只管写，交稿即接管杂务：

> 第 5 章写完了，贴给你。（正文直接粘进对话，或者说一声第 X 章写完、指个文件）

主编收稿后你会拿到三样东西：**审校意见清单**（只挑问题、不代改，改不改随你）、**账本回填**（伏笔/时间线/关系/记忆/线索五本账按你正文实际发生的记，计划外的改动也能认领，来源标 `backfill`）、**下一章章纲**（`novel/outlines/vXX-cXXX.md`，拿着就能写）。圣域纪律：`chapters/` 正文唯作者可改，agent 至多更新 frontmatter 的 summary 与五维字段，且先建议后动手。
配套命令：`maoying brief <dir> <章号>` 打包写作卡（章纲 + 前章结尾 + 角色卡 + 活跃伏笔，带去任意编辑器或其他 AI），`maoying check <dir>` 做零模型静态体检（frontmatter 完整性、伏笔章号引用与超期、章纲钩子小节、时间线乱序、AI 味统计（句式重复/比喻密度/句长节奏）、拍板账校验等，不调模型——LLM 审校走主编）。
随插件带 6 个网文方法论技能，插件启动时安装器把它们落盘到 `~/.dsh/skills/`（即 `<home>/skills/`）下的 `maoying-*` 六个目录，宿主技能面板可直接看到；大纲师、写手、审校、设定管理员按场景自动加载，你不用手动操作：

| 技能 | 一句话说明 |
|---|---|
| maoying-golden-opening | 黄金三章：开篇四型选型、前三章职能分工（世界钩子 → 动机确立 → 冲突引爆）、对抗格局聚焦与金手指原则、前 300 字出事原则、信息释放纪律与自检清单 |
| maoying-beat-pacing | 爽点节奏：即时正反馈环、期待感管理、爽点类型库与打脸节拍配比、压抑-释放配比、三级节奏曲线与章尾钩子选型 |
| maoying-review-checklist | 审校清单：语言/节奏/人设/逻辑/伏笔/剧透/风格七层逐项检查，按 P0/P1/P2 三档严重度输出 |
| maoying-foreshadow-discipline | 伏笔管理：铺垫与伏笔之辨、埋设即登记、推进节奏排期、回收「意外 + 合理」标准与台账清理阈值 |
| maoying-suspense-craft | 悬疑与对比：悖论式悬念、悬念-行动-线索循环、信息差四象限、堵死猜测与对比表现力技巧 |
| maoying-volume-craft | 卷纲与单元结构：卷四定（主题/收获/上限/刻度）、情节五步循环、支线字数红线、换地图纪律、群像戏份账与期待线并行 |

安装器只认 `maoying-*` 前缀目录，`~/.dsh/skills/` 下你自己的技能一个字节不动。卸载插件后技能目录需手动清理（六个目录一起删）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

`novel/` 目录是整个插件的数据库：project.yml（元信息与七阶段 phase）、style.md（写作风格基准）、volumes.yml、chapters/（frontmatter 五维叙事字段 + 正文）、characters/（角色卡）、world/、science/（三色设定）、relations.yml、foreshadows.yml（伏笔状态机）、timeline.yml、memories.yml（出场记录、承诺账、卷级梗概）、clue-board.yml、decisions.yml（拍板账）、research/、exports/。全部格式、示例与设计理由见：

- 速查版：项目初始化后的 `novel/README.md`（模板源 [templates/novel/README.md](templates/novel/README.md)）
- 完整版：[docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md)（为什么不用 SQLite、五维字段定义、伏笔状态机语义、出场记录约定）

```bash
maoying init [dir]     # 生成 novel/ 脚手架（默认 ./novel；已存在文件一律跳过，绝不覆盖）
maoying stats [dir]    # 逐章 CJK 字数、状态分布、当前 phase
maoying index [dir]    # 从 volumes.yml + chapters/ 重建 index.yml（派生文件）
maoying export [dir]   # 导出全书：--format md|txt|epub（默认 md），--out <目录> 改输出位置

export 示例：

```bash
maoying export novel                      # Markdown，落到 novel/exports/
maoying export novel --format txt         # 纯文本
maoying export novel --format epub        # EPUB 3（零依赖打包，可直接导入阅读器）
maoying export novel --format epub --out ~/Downloads   # 换输出目录

输出目录默认 `<dir>/exports/`，文件名 `<书名>-<YYYYMMDD>.<扩展名>`（书名取 project.yml 的 title）；章节解析与 stats/index 同一套逻辑，frontmatter 不会混进正文。

零依赖（node:fs/path/url/crypto），任意 cwd 可用。装法三选一：`npm install -g dsh-maoying`、随用随取的 `npx maoying <命令>`、或开发机的 `npm link`（仓库检出即改即生效）。三样都没有时 `node <插件目录>/bin/maoying.mjs` 等价（dsh 插件安装也会把包落进 profile，可直接指过去）。日常写作中 index.yml 由设定管理员直接重建，CLI 主要给人用。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets/maoying"
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

宿主是 DSH 0.1.7+ 时再补一步：删去 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 dsh-maoying 托管块（`# --- dsh-maoying preset managed (auto-generated; do not edit) ---` 到 `# --- end dsh-maoying preset managed ---` 之间的整段，含两行标记），免得留下指向已删目录的声明行；Android compat 壳上托管块写在 profile 层，`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 里的同名托管块也照此删除。`novel/` 目录是你的书稿，卸载插件不会动它。

插件启动时读宿主版本，按版本自动选择委派行形状——**宿主升级后重启即切换，无需重装插件**。版本探测是五级探针（argv[1] → 全 argv 扫描 → app.asar / desktop-runtime → Electron API → home 全局兜底），前四级锚定当前进程的真实宿主，`<home>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json` 那份 home 全局安装只做最后兜底（老 CLI 残留可能陈旧几个大版本）；每级读到了什么可查创作台面板的 `host-debug` 端点（路径已脱敏）：

- **DSH 0.1.7 – 0.2.1-rc.1 → v1 内联形状**：5 个角色委派行直接内联 persona 与 toolFilter，托管块 1 条声明行。
- **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2+ → v2 AgentPreset 形状**：该版本起 dsh-tool-subagent 拒绝内联 persona/toolFilter，插件改用 [presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml](presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml)——托管块写 6 条声明行（主编 preset + 大纲师/写手/审校/设定管理员/素材调研员 5 张角色 preset），主编委派行以 `agentPreset` 指向角色 preset，角色的工具面由 preset 里的实体工具行承载（审校只读、考据带联网检索）。
- **DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2+ → v2 形状剥离 list-agents 行**：0.2.2 起宿主把 `list_agents` 工具并入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control` 主导出并删除 `./list-agents` 子路径导出——旧声明行在 0.2.2+ 上模块解析失败，注册表审计会把整张主编 preset 判 broken、从选择器消失（issue #7，0.2.2-rc.1 实测复现）。组装时按宿主版本自动剥离该行（list_agents 能力无损，由 control 主导出自带注册）；0.2.1 系宿主不受影响，声明行照旧保留。
- **角色预设会出现在预设选择器**（宿主对预设没有隐藏机制），name 带「（内部）」标明：日常写作由主编委派自动选用，不经主编、想单独开一个写手/考据会话时直接选中即可。
- 两种形状的 persona 文本同源逐字一致（[test/composition.test.mjs](test/composition.test.mjs) 逐字节把关）；宿主版本完全未知（五级探针全败）时不写声明行、预设文件照落走 partial 自愈，绝不把可能已 ≥0.2.1-rc.2 的宿主声明成 v1 内联（下次启动版本可读时自动补写）。

**Maoying** literally means "the brush" — in *Maoying Zhuan* (毛颖传, "The Biography of the Brush"), Han Yu wrote a writing brush as a courtier with a fief and a title. dsh-maoying fits that brush into DSH (DeepSeek Harness): **a brush that manages a crew of helpers and guards a stack of manuscripts** — a web-novel writing assistant plugin, fully original, released under MIT.

Once installed, the main agent becomes the **editor-in-chief of your novel**: it runs a seven-phase workflow with a six-step writing method, delegating outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers who each carry only their own tools. The whole novel is a structured markdown/YAML `novel/` directory in the workspace (character cards, foreshadowing state machine, timeline, clue board, narrative memory) — agents read and write files directly, **no database, no API layer**. "Show all unresolved foreshadowing" is one line of grep.

- **Editor-in-chief + five helpers**: the main agent plans, connects, reviews and advances states; the outliner (outline), writer (write), reviewer (review), lore keeper (lore) and researcher (research) each carry their own tools. Trivial errands like finding a file or checking a foreshadow status, the chief handles itself with glob/grep.
- **novel/ as a file database**: character cards, worldbuilding & science settings with three-color tags, relations graph, foreshadow ledger, timeline, narrative memory, clue board, decisions ledger — all grep-friendly flat-key/top-level-array YAML, human-editable, git-versioned, no migrations, no ops.
- **Seven-phase workflow**: idea → setting → outline → writing → review → consistency → export. The phase lives in the `phase` key of project.yml; the chief advances it at each milestone and reports to you, with completion gates (core settings saved; volume plan and the target chapter outline in place before writing) — unmet, it steps back a phase.
- **Writing six-step method**: continuity check → outline → draft → review → revision → finalization, looping per chapter; paired with the Collab four-step co-writing flow (setting co-creation → volume pl

Prerequisites: **Node.js ≥ 18** and an installed DSH host (**0.1.7+**, see "Compatibility").

The official plugin channel — one command, then restart:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maoying
```

**Restart DSH (`dsh web`)**: at startup the plugin installs the preset into `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/maoying/` and writes the managed declaration block — no buttons to press. The block's patch layer is picked automatically: desktop/server installs write the home-level `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`; on the Android compat shell (which mangles the home-level patch on every start) the plugin writes the profile-level `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` instead — the shell never touches that layer, so the plugin re-writes it on each boot to self-heal and removes the stale home-level block to avoid double declarations. Set `DSH_MAOYING_PATCH_LAYER=home|profile` to override. Pick "**毛颖创作 (Maoying)**" in the preset selector of a new session; to make it default, select it in Settings → Agent Presets.

For a development checkout (you want to modify the plugin or preset sources), link the repo directly; changes take effect after a restart:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-maoying.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-maoying"
```

Only want the command-line tool, without the plugin? The zero-dependency CLI works standalone via `npx`, or as a global command (both npm channels, independent of the plugin):

```bash
npx maoying init                 # run without installing
npm install -g dsh-maoying       # or install a global maoying command
```

With the preset selected, just talk to the chief; it routes by the workflow itself:

**Start a new book (Collab four-step co-writing)**:

> I want to write an Eastern fantasy where the protagonist's golden finger is hearing objects speak and appraising treasures to level up.

The chief aligns the setting with you item by item (genre, golden finger, tone, the protagonist's want/obstacle/leverage, the core opposition); the lore keeper saves core character cards and worldbuilding entries for your sign-off, the outliner's volume plan gets a second sign-off — only then are the golden three chapters (world hook, protagonist motivation, core conflict) written and delivered.

**Per-chapter writing (Writing six-step method)**:

> Can we start chapter 3?

The chief runs the continuity check, has the outliner produce the chapter outline (with the five narrative dimensions), and after your sign-off sends it to the writer, then the reviewer (checklist + consistency scan: conflicts / timeline / foreshadowing / settings plus the six coherence dimensions — behavior / causality / resources / identity / injuries / combat power); issues go back to the writer; once passing, the lore keeper runs finalization upkeep as one atomic pass (outline cross-check + five ledgers + index rebuild + consistency sweep — accepted only when everything is on disk) — you only call the shots at decision points.

**Consistency pass**:

> Run a consistency check over the first 20 chapters.

The chief advances the phase to consistency; the reviewer scans conflicts / timeline / foreshadowing / settings plus the six coherence dimensions (behavior / causality / resources / identity / injuries / combat power) and returns issues ranked by severity.

A reply of "ok / sure / go on" counts as confirmation; the chief advances directly without echoing it back.

Open "**毛颖创作台**" at the bottom of the DSH sidebar — a full-page cockpit for the human eye, beyond what agents do. The open layout is a three-way choice in the panel's Settings (remembered immediately, applies to the next open):

Right-sidebar tabs survive tab switches / session switches / panel collapse (drafts stay alive); reopening pulls the latest content. Switching chapters in the article page remounts the editor — unsaved drafts within the 30-second autosave window are not preserved. Center-column behavior is unchanged:

- **Chapters**: status filters + the writing queue; click a chapter for full-page reading — back button, outline side-by-side (Markdown rendered), in-place editing with save for the manuscript and the outline. The manuscript textarea **auto-saves** (about a 30-second debounce): pending empty chapters and chapters with status=writing open straight into the editor, manual and auto saves both stay in the editor for continuous writing, Enter inserts two full-width spaces of paragraph indent, the edit bar shows a live character count in both calibers (with and without punctuation), the chapter title can be edited at the top of the editor (saved atomically with the body), and the editor carries logical line numbers aligned with soft wraps, the editor font size is zoomable (A−/A+, remembered in localStorage), the editor font is selectable (dropdown: system default + Hei/Song/Kai/FangSong/LXGW WenKai, applied to both reading and editing from a single source, remembered in localStorage), one-click "Read mode" return to read-only view (confirms if unsaved); the outline textarea saves manually; if the file was changed externally while editing, saving is rejected and the latest content restore

The panel writes state (chapter status, project.yml, index.yml rebuilds), and every human editing entry — prose, outlines, ledgers, entity cards — is for humans only (hash-based stale-write detection plus structural validation; external changes are never overwritten); the agent boundary is unchanged: in co-writing, prose belongs to the author and the chief.

Not everyone wants AI ghostwriting. The `mode` key in project.yml decides who writes the prose — three modes in one line each: `ai-draft` (default) AI drafts via the Writing six-step method; `co-write` assigns a writer per chapter, and the chief asks who writes before touching the pen; `author-draft` the author writes the whole book, and Maoying only preps, reviews and keeps the books — never ghostwrites.

The author-draft loop — you just write, hand it over, and the chores are taken care of:

> Chapter 5 is done, here it is. (paste the text, or just say chapter X is done and point at a file)

After receiving a manuscript you get three things: a **review checklist** (issues only, no rewriting — applying them is up to you), a **ledger backfill** (foreshadowing / timeline / relations / memory / clue board recorded from what your text actually does, even off-plan changes, tagged `backfill`), and the **next chapter outline** (`novel/outlines/vXX-cXXX.md`, ready to write from).

Companion commands: `maoying brief <dir> <chapter>` packs a per-chapter writing card (outline + previous ending + character cards + active foreshadowing — carry it to any editor or AI), and `maoying check <dir>` runs a zero-model static check (frontmatter completeness, foreshadow chapter refs & staleness, outline hook section, timeline ordering, AI-flavor stats (repeated openers / metaphor density / sentence-length flatness), decisions-ledger checks, phase readiness gates — no model calls; LLM review goes through the chief).

The installer only touches `maoying-*` prefixed directories; your own skills under `~/.dsh/skills/` are untouched, byte for byte. After uninstalling the plugin, remove the skill directories manually (all six together):

The `novel/` directory is the plugin's entire database: project.yml (metadata + seven-phase state), style.md (the writing style baseline), volumes.yml, chapters/ (frontmatter five narrative dimensions + prose), characters/ (character cards), world/, science/ (three-color settings), relations.yml, foreshadows.yml (the state machine), timeline.yml, memories.yml (with appearance records and the promise ledger), clue-board.yml, decisions.yml (the decisions ledger), research/, exports/. Full formats, examples and design rationale:

- Quick reference: `novel/README.md` after project init (template source: [templates/novel/README.md](templates/novel/README.md))
- Full spec: [docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md) (why not SQLite, five-dimension field definitions, foreshadow state-machine semantics, appearance-record conventions)

```bash
maoying init [dir]     # scaffold novel/ (default ./novel; existing files are always skipped, never overwritten)
maoying stats [dir]    # per-chapter CJK counts, status breakdown, current phase
maoying index [dir]    # rebuild index.yml from volumes.yml + chapters/ (derived file)
maoying export [dir]   # export the book: --format md|txt|epub (default md), --out <dir> to change destination

Export examples:

```bash
maoying export novel                      # Markdown, into novel/exports/
maoying export novel --format txt         # plain text
maoying export novel --format epub        # EPUB 3 (zero-dependency packaging, importable into readers)
maoying export novel --format epub --out ~/Downloads   # different destination

The output directory defaults to `<dir>/exports/`, file name `<title>-<YYYYMMDD>.<ext>` (title from project.yml); chapter parsing shares the same logic as stats/index, so frontmatter never leaks into prose.

Zero dependencies (node:fs/path/url/crypto), runs from any cwd. Install one of three ways: `npm install -g dsh-maoying`, on-demand `npx maoying <command>`, or `npm link` on a dev machine (repo checkout, edits take effect immediately). With none of these, `node <plugin dir>/bin/maoying.mjs` is equivalent (a dsh plugin install also drops the package into the profile, so you can point there directly). In day-to-day writing the lore keeper rebuilds index.yml directly; the CLI is mainly for humans.

```
